name: AECi — Linear pipeline failure rate > 50% (1h)
message:
More than 50% of Linear write-pipeline attempts failed over 1h (AECI-219 / Phase 6.12). This combines the request→Linear creation (`aeci.linear.issue`, AECI-211 / 6.4) and the admin resolve/reject site→Linear sync (`aeci.linear.sync`, AECI-213 / 6.6) — both `outcome:failed` over terminal attempts (`ok` + `failed`; the `skipped_exists` idempotent re-fire and `skipped_no_issue` no-op are excluded from the denominator so they can't mask a spike). A high RATE means SYSTEMIC breakage — a revoked/missing `LINEAR_API_KEY`, drifted board/label/assignee ids in `lib/linear.ts`, or Linear being down — not a single transient failure. This is the early-detection complement to `AECi — Linear reconciliation: persistent stuck requests`, which is the per-row backstop that only fires after the ~60m persistent threshold; it also covers the SYNC path, which has NO reconciliation retry (a failed resolve/reject silently diverges Linear from Supabase). Pivot the 'AECi Phase 6 — Requests/Moderation' dashboard / Metrics Explorer by `reason` (`http_error 401/403` → key missing/revoked/over-scope; `graphql_error` → drifted ids; `timeout`/`network` → Linear slow/down; `db_error` → link-back/transition write failed) and read `service:aeci-api` logs.

Note: deliberately NO notify_no_data — the Linear pipeline is traffic-driven (no submits / no resolves = no points), and the absent-key path emits NOTHING, so zero data is the healthy pre-launch state and a no-data alert would be constant noise. The 50% threshold + 1h window are launch-tunable starting points (at low volume a single failure can dominate the ratio) — retune once production traffic is known.

Runbook: https://github.com/the-wbs-project/aec-integrations/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOKS.md#linear-pipeline-failure-issue-creation--sync
